title: C1 — What does the kitchen contain?

meta.ablation: Synthetic WHERE-only, n=20, episodic top-50 vs + spatial top-25

question.text: What does the kitchen contain according to the recorded spatial layout?

video.note: Synthetic WHERE-only case; source catalog provides no EgoLifeQA video window. Thumbnail is docs/slides/assets/kitchen_stool.jpg, a kitchen scene with stool, not the exact target frame.

fine_caption_window.note: Synthetic WHERE-only case; source catalog supplies the observed contains triple but no 30-second EgoLifeQA caption window.

why_spatial_won: This is the cleanest "spatial-only ground truth" example. The model has a strong world prior that kitchens contain fridges; only the spatial layer's observed triple `(kitchen, contains, light)` (the recording captured someone noting the kitchen lights specifically) breaks the prior.

fonts.sans: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

ppt_export_hints.powerpoint: use python-pptx; map gold choice to green accent fill, both prediction cards to red/green outline; embed the .mp4 once downloaded from `video.url`.
ppt_export_hints.google_slides: use Slides API + a 'placeholder' text-box layout; insert `video.url` as the Drive video link after a one-time upload.
ppt_export_hints.keynote: import the HTML renderer at design.html_renderer as a single full-bleed image (Keynote does not render HTML natively).
